```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width = 30, fig.height = 22, dpi=1200, echo=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Effect sizes for highlighted positions
pos_meta <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Position, ~effect_size,
    982341,   0.000008,
   1067762,   0.140653,
    811499,   3.562828,
    323379,   2.431675
) %>%
  mutate(beta_lab = sprintf("\u03B2=%s", signif(effect_size, 3)))

# Colors (Okabe–Ito palette)
col_vals <- setNames(
  c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#009E73", "#CC79A7"),
  pos_meta$beta_lab
)

df <- Genome_dataset %>%
  filter(Generation <= 1000) %>%
  left_join(pos_meta, by = "Position") %>%
  mutate(is_highlight = !is.na(effect_size))

# Right-edge labels (effect only)
lab_df <- df %>%
  filter(is_highlight) %>%
  group_by(Selection, Position, beta_lab) %>%
  filter(Generation == max(Generation)) %>%
  ungroup()

AF_FS_model_comparison <-
  ggplot(df, aes(Generation, Frequency, group = Position)) +
  # Background
  geom_line(data = dplyr::filter(df, !is_highlight),
            color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  # Highlights (legend keyed by β only)
  geom_line(data = dplyr::filter(df, is_highlight),
            aes(color = beta_lab), linewidth = 1.1, alpha = 0.95) +
  # On-plot labels showing β only
  # geom_text(data = lab_df,
  #           aes(label = beta_lab, color = beta_lab),
  #           hjust = 0, nudge_x = 12, size = 3.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Effect size", values = col_vals) +
 # scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.10))) +
  facet_wrap(Selection ~ .) +
  labs(x = "Generation", y = "Allele Frequency") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  mythemes

ggsave("Figure6.jpg", 
       plot = AF_FS_model_comparison, 
       dpi = 600, width = 30, height = 20,

print(AF_FS_model_comparison)
```

### 2. AF All models comparisons

```{r,  warning=FALSE, fig.width = 30, fig.height = 22, dpi=1200, echo=FALSE}
# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(cowplot)

n_values <- c(1, 10, 100) # Loci to compare
gene_number_labels <- c("1" = "1 Locus", "10" = "10 Loci", "100" = "100 Loci")

selections <- list(#"LinFS.dir" = "Instantaneous",
  "SinFS.dir" = "Gradual 2-Seasons",
  "SinFSGen.dir" = "Gradual 4-Seasons Same \u0394",
  "FourSeasFourAmp.dir" = "Gradual 4-Seasons Different \u0394"
)

dataset_list <- list()

for (n in n_values) {
  for (dir_name in names(selections)) {
    selection_label <- selections[[dir_name]]
    if (dir_name == "SinFSGen.dir") {
      filename <- paste0("../../Output.dir/", dir_name, "/genome10_n", n, "_H0.5SD4.csv")
    }else if(dir_name == "FourSeasFourAmp.dir"){
      filename <- paste0("../../Output.dir/", dir_name, "/genome10_n", n, "_H0.5.csv")
    } else {
      filename <- paste0("../../Output.dir/", dir_name, "/genome10_n", n, "_H0.5SD4Gen20.csv")
    }
    
    if (file.exists(filename)) {
      data <- read.csv(filename)
      
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(Selection = selection_label,
          Gene_Number = gene_number_labels[as.character(n)])
      
      dataset_list[[length(dataset_list) + 1]] <- data
    } else {
      warning(paste("File not found:", filename))
    }
  }
}

Genome_dataset <- bind_rows(dataset_list) %>%
  mutate(
    Selection = fct_relevel(Selection,"Instantaneous", "Gradual 2-Seasons", "Gradual 4-Seasons Same \u0394", "Gradual 4-Seasons Different \u0394"), #"Instantaneous", 
    Gene_Number = fct_relevel(Gene_Number, "1 Locus", "10 Loci", "100 Loci")
  )

monogenic_positions <- Genome_dataset %>%
  filter(Gene_Number == "1 Locus") %>%
  pull(Position) %>%
  unique()
monogenic_highlight <- ifelse(length(monogenic_positions) >= 1, monogenic_positions[1], NA)

highlight_positions <- data.frame(
  Gene_Number = c("1 Locus", "10 Loci", "100 Loci"),
  Highlight_Position = c(monogenic_highlight, 427101, 323379) # 1037246, 201349
)

Genome_dataset <- Genome_dataset %>%
  left_join(highlight_positions, by = "Gene_Number") %>%
  mutate(Highlight = Position == Highlight_Position)


# Get all positions for Polygenic
Polygenic_positions <- Genome_dataset %>%
  filter(Gene_Number == "100 Loci") %>%
  pull(Position) %>%
  unique()

Polygenic_highlight <- highlight_positions %>%
  filter(Gene_Number == "100 Loci") %>%
  pull(Highlight_Position)

# Remove the highlighted position from positions to sample 
positions_to_sample <- setdiff(Polygenic_positions, Polygenic_highlight)

# Randomly sample 29 positions (since we have 1 highlighted position)
set.seed(123) 
sampled_positions <- sample(positions_to_sample, 
                            size = min(29, length(positions_to_sample)), 
                            replace = FALSE)

selected_Polygenic_positions <- c(sampled_positions, Polygenic_highlight)

Genome_dataset_filtered <- Genome_dataset %>%
  filter(
    (Gene_Number != "100 Loci") | (Position %in% selected_Polygenic_positions)
  )

All_models_freq <- Genome_dataset_filtered %>% 
  filter(Generation <= 1000) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Generation, 
             y = Frequency, 
             group = factor(Position), 
             color = as.factor(Highlight),
             size = as.factor(Highlight))) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 2, "FALSE" = 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "magenta", "FALSE" = "grey")) +
  labs(title = "A) Allele Frequency", x = "Generation", y = "Frequency") +
  facet_grid(Selection ~ Gene_Number) +
  theme_bw()+
  mythemes


print(All_models_freq)
```

```{r,  warning=FALSE, fig.width = 30, fig.height = 22, dpi=1200, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| label: All_models_Pheno

n_values <- c(1, 10, 100)
gene_number_labels <- c("1" = "1 Locus", "10" = "10 Loci", "100" = "100 Loci")

selections <- list(
  #"LinFS.dir" = "Instantaneous",
  "SinFS.dir" = "Gradual 2-Seasons",
  "SinFSGen.dir" = "Gradual 4-Seasons Same \u0394",
  "FourSeasFourAmp.dir" = "Gradual 4-Seasons Different \u0394"
)

for (n in n_values) {
  for (dir_name in names(selections)) {
    selection_label <- selections[[dir_name]]
    if (dir_name == "SinFSGen.dir") {
      file_pattern <- paste0("MeanPhenotypes\\d+_n", n, "_H0\\.5SD4\\.csv$")
```

### 4. Spectral All models comparisons

```{r,  warning=FALSE, fig.width = 30, fig.height = 18, dpi=1600, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| label: All_models_Spec
n_values <- c(1, 10,100)#1, 
gene_number_labels <- c("1" = "1 Locus", "10" = "10 Loci", "100" = "100 Loci", "300" = "300 Loci")

selections <- list(
#"LinFS.dir" = "Instantaneous",
"SinFS.dir" = "Gradual 2-Seasons",
"SinFSGen.dir" = "Gradual 4-Seasons Same \u0394", 
"FourSeasFourAmp.dir" = "Gradual 4-Seasons Different \u0394"
)

allele_freq_list <- list()
for (n in n_values) {
  for (dir_name in names(selections)) {
    selection_label <- selections[[dir_name]]
    if (dir_name == "SinFSGen.dir") {
      file_pattern <- paste0("genome\\d+_n", n, "_H0\\.5SD2\\.csv$")
      file_path <- paste0("../../Output.dir/", dir_name)
    }else if (dir_name == "FourSeasFourAmp.dir") {
      file_pattern <- paste0("genome\\d+_n", n, "_H0\\.5\\.csv$")
      file_path <- paste0("../../Output.dir/", dir_name)
    } else {
      file_pattern <- paste0("genome\\d+_n", n, "_H0\\.5SD2Gen20\\.csv$")
      file_path <- paste0("../../Output.dir/", dir_name)
    }
    
    file_list <- list.files(
      path = file_path,
      pattern = file_pattern,
      full.names = TRUE
    )
    
    for (file in file_list) {
      data <- read.csv(file) #%>% filter(Generation >=1800)
      replicate_value <- as.numeric( sub(".*genome(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", basename(file)))
      
      data <- data %>%
        mutate(
          Selection = selection_label,
          Gene_Number = gene_number_labels[as.character(n)],
          Replicate = factor(replicate_value)
        )
      
      allele_freq_list[[length(allele_freq_list) + 1]] <- data
    }
  }
}

AlleleFreq_dataset <- bind_rows(allele_freq_list) %>%
  mutate(
    Selection = fct_relevel(Selection, "Instantaneous", "Gradual 2-Seasons", "Gradual 4-Seasons Same \u0394", "Gradual 4-Seasons Different \u0394"),
    Gene_Number = fct_relevel(Gene_Number, "1 Locus", "10 Loci", "100 Loci", "300 Loci")
  )

  num_cores_to_use <- min(detectCores() - 16, 32) # check the cores before
  cluster_type   <- if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") "PSOCK" else "FORK"
  cl <- makeCluster(num_cores_to_use, type = cluster_type)
  registerDoParallel(cl)

grouped_data <- AlleleFreq_dataset %>%
  group_by(Selection, Gene_Number, Replicate)

unique_combinations <- grouped_data %>%
  summarize() %>%
  ungroup()

spectral_results <- foreach(i = 1:nrow(unique_combinations), .packages = c("dplyr", "stats")) %dopar% {
  sel <- unique_combinations$Selection[i]
  gene_num <- unique_combinations$Gene_Number[i]
  rep <- unique_combinations$Replicate[i]
  
  df <- AlleleFreq_dataset %>%
    filter(Selection == sel, Gene_Number == gene_num, Replicate == rep) %>%
    arrange(Generation)
  
  mean_freq_df <- df %>%
    group_by(Generation) %>%
    summarize(Mean_Frequency = mean(Frequency, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(Generation)
  
ts_data <- ts(mean_freq_df$Mean_Frequency, 
              start = min(mean_freq_df$Generation), frequency = 1)
  
spec_result <- spectrum(ts_data, spans = 2, plot = FALSE)
period <- 1 / spec_result$freq
  
  data.frame(
    Period = period,
    Spectrum = spec_result$spec,
    Selection = sel,
    Gene_Number = gene_num,
    Replicate = rep
  )
}

# Stop cluster
stopCluster(cl)

spectral_data <- bind_rows(spectral_results)

spectral_data <- spectral_data %>%
  filter(Period < 80)

All_models_Spec <- spectral_data %>%
  mutate(
    Facet_formula = factor(
      paste0(Gene_Number, " ", Selection),
      levels = c(
        "1 Locus Instantaneous", "10 Loci Instantaneous", "100 Loci Instantaneous",  "300 Loci Instantaneous",
        "1 Locus Gradual 2-Seasons", "10 Loci Gradual 2-Seasons", "100 Loci Gradual 2-Seasons",  "300 Loci Gradual 2-Seasons",
        "1 Locus Gradual 4-Seasons Same \u0394", "10 Loci Gradual 4-Seasons Same \u0394", "100 Loci Gradual 4-Seasons Same \u0394" , "300 Loci Gradual 4-Seasons Same \u0394" ,
        "1 Locus Gradual 4-Seasons Different \u0394", "10 Loci Gradual 4-Seasons Different \u0394", "100 Loci Gradual 4-Seasons Different \u0394", "300 Loci Gradual 4-Seasons Different \u0394"
      )
    )
  ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Period, y = Spectrum, group = Replicate, color = Replicate)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 1, size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number())+
  #facet_wrap( ~ Selection + Gene_Number, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
  facet_wrap( ~ Facet_formula, scales = "free", ncol = 3, dir = "h") +
  #scale_color_viridis_d() +  # Use a discrete color palette
  labs(
    x = "Period (Generations)",
    y = "Spectral Density",
    color = "Replicate"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Spectral Density", x = "Period (Generations)",
       y = "Spectral Density")+
  theme_bw()+
  mythemes
    
# 
# ggsave("All_models_Spec.jpg", plot = All_models_Spec, dpi = 600, width = 49, height = 30, units = "in", path = "../OutputFigures.dir")

ggsave("Figure7.jpg",  plot = All_models_Spec, width = 70, height = 30, units = "in", path = "../OutputFigures.dir", limitsize = FALSE)

print(All_models_Spec)

```

```{r,  warning=FALSE, fig.width = 35, fig.height = 12, dpi=1200, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# ---- Libraries ----
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)

# ---- Params & labels ----
n_values <- c(1, 10, 100)
gene_number_labels <- c("1" = "1 Locus", "10" = "10 Loci", "100" = "100 Loci")

# Human-readable labels for each directory
selections <- list(
  # "LinFS.dir"         = "Instantaneous",  # keep commented if not used
  "SinFS.dir"         = "Gradual 2-Seasons",
  "SinFSGen.dir"      = "Gradual 4-Seasons Same \u0394",
  "FourSeasFourAmp.dir" = "Gradual 4-Seasons Different \u0394"
)

# Optional theme injector (keeps your 'mythemes' if defined)
theme_add <- if (exists("mythemes", inherits = TRUE)) mythemes else theme()

# ---- Read all files ----
allele_freq_list <- list()

for (n in n_values) {
  for (dir_name in names(selections)) {
    selection_label <- selections[[dir_name]]

    # Build file patterns per directory, matching your naming scheme
    if (dir_name == "SinFSGen.dir") {
      file_pattern <- paste0("genome\\d+_n", n, "_H0\\.5SD4\\.csv$")
      file_path <- file.path("../../Output.dir", dir_name)
    } else if (dir_name == "FourSeasFourAmp.dir") {
      file_pattern <- paste0("genome\\d+_n", n, "_H0\\.5\\.csv$")
      file_path <- file.path("../../Output.dir", dir_name)
    } else {
      file_pattern <- paste0("genome\\d+_n", n, "_H0\\.5SD4Gen10\\.csv$")
      file_path <- file.path("../../Output.dir", dir_name)
    }

    file_list <- list.files(path = file_path, pattern = file_pattern, full.names = TRUE)

    if (length(file_list) == 0) {
      message(sprintf("No files matched in %s with pattern %s", file_path, file_pattern))
      next
    }

    for (file in file_list) {
      data <- read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      replicate_value <- as.numeric(sub(".*genome(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", basename(file)))

      data <- data %>%
        mutate(
          Selection   = selection_label,
          Gene_Number = gene_number_labels[as.character(n)],
          Replicate   = factor(replicate_value)
        )

      allele_freq_list[[length(allele_freq_list) + 1]] <- data
    }
  }
}

if (length(allele_freq_list) == 0) {
  stop("No input files found; check file paths/patterns.")
}

AlleleFreq_dataset <- bind_rows(allele_freq_list) %>%
  mutate(
    Selection = fct_relevel(
      Selection,
      "Instantaneous", "Gradual 2-Seasons", "Gradual 4-Seasons Same \u0394", "Gradual 4-Seasons Different \u0394"
    ),
    Gene_Number = fct_relevel(Gene_Number, "1 Locus", "10 Loci", "100 Loci")
  )

# ---- Parallel setup ----
dc <- parallel::detectCores(logical = TRUE)
num_cores_to_use <- max(1, min(dc - 16, 32))  # safe guard
cluster_type <- if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") "PSOCK" else "FORK"
cl <- parallel::makeCluster(num_cores_to_use, type = cluster_type)
doParallel::registerDoParallel(cl)
on.exit(try(parallel::stopCluster(cl), silent = TRUE), add = TRUE)

# ---- Mean-of-spectra per (Selection, Gene_Number, Replicate) ----
# Helper: compute averaged spectrum across loci for one group df
compute_mean_spectrum <- function(df_group) {
  df_group <- df_group %>% arrange(Generation)

  positions <- sort(unique(df_group$Position))
  if (length(positions) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(Period = numeric(0), Spectrum = numeric(0)))
  }

  # Per-locus spectra list (same sampling; expect same freq grid)
  spec_list <- lapply(positions, function(pos) {
    sub <- df_group[df_group$Position == pos, c("Generation", "Frequency")]
    sub <- sub[order(sub$Generation), , drop = FALSE]
    series <- sub$Frequency

    # Require non-NA series
    if (anyNA(series)) return(NULL)

    # Compute spectrum
    res <- stats::spectrum(ts(series, frequency = 1), spans = 2, plot = FALSE)
    data.frame(freq = res$freq, spec = res$spec)
  })

  spec_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), spec_list)
  if (length(spec_list) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(Period = numeric(0), Spectrum = numeric(0)))
  }

  # Align lengths (truncate to the minimal n.freq if needed)
  n_vec <- vapply(spec_list, function(x) nrow(x), integer(1))
  n_min <- min(n_vec)
  spec_mat <- do.call(cbind, lapply(spec_list, function(x) x$spec[seq_len(n_min)]))
  base_freq <- spec_list[[1]]$freq[seq_len(n_min)]

  spec_mean <- rowMeans(spec_mat, na.rm = TRUE)

  # Drop zero frequency before converting to period
  keep <- base_freq > 0
  period <- 1 / base_freq[keep]
  spec_mean <- spec_mean[keep]

  data.frame(Period = period, Spectrum = spec_mean)
}

# Unique combinations to iterate
unique_combinations <- AlleleFreq_dataset %>%
  distinct(Selection, Gene_Number, Replicate)

spectral_results <- foreach::foreach(
  i = 1:nrow(unique_combinations),
  .packages = c("dplyr", "stats")
) %dopar% {
  sel      <- unique_combinations$Selection[i]
  gene_num <- unique_combinations$Gene_Number[i]
  rep      <- unique_combinations$Replicate[i]

  df <- AlleleFreq_dataset %>%
    filter(Selection == sel, Gene_Number == gene_num, Replicate == rep)

  out <- compute_mean_spectrum(df)
  if (nrow(out) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  transform(out,
            Selection = sel,
            Gene_Number = gene_num,
            Replicate = rep)
}

spectral_data <- bind_rows(Filter(Negate(is.null), spectral_results)) %>%
  filter(Period < 40)

# ---- Facet label factor ----
spectral_data <- spectral_data %>%
  mutate(
    Facet_formula = factor(
      paste0(Gene_Number, " ", Selection),
      levels = c(
        "1 Locus Instantaneous", "10 Loci Instantaneous", "100 Loci Instantaneous",
        "1 Locus Gradual 2-Seasons", "10 Loci Gradual 2-Seasons", "100 Loci Gradual 2-Seasons",
        "1 Locus Gradual 4-Seasons Same \u0394", "10 Loci Gradual 4-Seasons Same \u0394", "100 Loci Gradual 4-Seasons Same \u0394",
        "1 Locus Gradual 4-Seasons Different \u0394", "10 Loci Gradual 4-Seasons Different \u0394", "100 Loci Gradual 4-Seasons Different \u0394"
      )
    )
  )

# ---- Plot ----
All_models_Spec <-
  ggplot(spectral_data, aes(x = Period, y = Spectrum, group = Replicate, color = Replicate)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 1, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number()) +
  facet_wrap(~ Facet_formula, scales = "free", ncol = 4, dir = "v") +
  labs(
    title = "C) Spectral Density",
    x = "Period (Generations)",
    y = "Spectral Density",
    color = "Replicate"
  ) +
  theme_bw() + theme_add

print(All_models_Spec)
```
